attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 936790)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Life_Is_Strange:_True_Colors
Fandom (life-is-strange.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://life-is-strange.fandom.com/wiki/Life_is_Strange:_True_Colors
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). All 40 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. Their Steam API names carry chapter prefixes (CH1_ to CH5_, plus COLLECT_ALL), so each achievement was placed in its chapter by exact name; each chapter has a story-complete achievement (CHn_COMPLETE) and a collection achievement (CHn_COLLECT), and the rest are tagged _C_ or _F_ with scene codes. The Steam schema calls the app "Siren" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 936790. StrategyWiki has the game under "Life Is Strange: True Colors" (capital "Is"; the lower-case title is missing), at completion stage 0 and marked as a stub; only its "Table of Contents" subpage is written. That contents page links chapter pages for Chapters 1 to 3 plus Collectible memories and Achievements pages, none of them written, so nothing was used and chapter titles here are plain numbers. lifeisstrange.fandom.com has no page under this title; life-is-strange.fandom.com answers the API under "Life is Strange: True Colors" with about 79 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
